probe:
GCC             gcc-16
version         16.2.0
plugin headers  $(brew --prefix)/Cellar/gcc/16.2.0/bin/../lib/gcc/current/gcc/aarch64-apple-darwin24/16/plugin/include
gcc-plugin.h    present
uname           Darwin
compiles c++    yes
gmp.h on path   no
CPPFLAGS        -I$(brew --prefix)/Cellar/gcc/16.2.0/bin/../lib/gcc/current/gcc/aarch64-apple-darwin24/16/plugin/include -I$(brew --prefix)/include -I$(brew --prefix)/opt/llvm/include
link flags       -Wl,-undefined,dynamic_lookup

plain.asm:
.arch armv8.5-a
	.build_version macos,  15, 0
	.text
	.align	2
	.p2align 5,,15
	.globl _nearest
_nearest:
LFB1:
	cmp	w1, 1
	ble	L5
	ldp	w7, w3, [x0]
	asr	x8, x2, 32
	add	x5, x0, 8
	mov	w6, 1
	mov	w0, 0
	sub	w3, w3, w8
	sub	w7, w7, w2
	mul	w3, w3, w3
	madd	w7, w7, w7, w3
	.p2align 5,,15
L4:
	ldp	w4, w3, [x5], 8
	sub	w4, w4, w2
	sub	w3, w3, w8
	mul	w4, w4, w4
	madd	w3, w3, w3, w4
	cmp	w7, w3
	csel	w0, w0, w6, le
	add	w6, w6, 1
	csel	w7, w7, w3, le
	cmp	w1, w6
	bne	L4
	ret
	.p2align 2,,3
L5:
	mov	w0, 0
	ret
LFE1:
	.section __TEXT,__eh_frame,coalesced,no_toc+strip_static_syms+live_support
EH_frame1:
	.set L$set$0,LECIE1-LSCIE1
	.long L$set$0
LSCIE1:
	.long	0
	.byte	0x3
	.ascii "zR\0"
	.uleb128 0x1
	.sleb128 -8
	.uleb128 0x1e
	.uleb128 0x1
	.byte	0x10
	.byte	0xc
	.uleb128 0x1f
	.uleb128 0
	.align	3
LECIE1:
LSFDE1:
	.set L$set$1,LEFDE1-LASFDE1
	.long L$set$1
LASFDE1:
	.long	LASFDE1-EH_frame1
	.quad	LFB1-.
	.set L$set$2,LFE1-LFB1
	.quad L$set$2
	.uleb128 0
	.align	3
LEFDE1:
	.ident	"GCC: (Homebrew GCC 16.2.0) 16.2.0"
	.subsections_via_symbols

	.text
	.align	2
	.p2align 5,,15
	.globl _nearest

	ble	L5
	ldp	w6, w3, [x0]

	mov	w7, 0
	sub	w3, w3, w9
	sub	w6, w6, w2
	mul	w3, w3, w3
	madd	w6, w6, w6, w3
	.p2align 5,,15

	add	x8, x0, x3
	ldr	w3, [x8, 4]

	mul	w4, w4, w4

	madd	w3, w3, w3, w4

	csel	w7, w7, w5, le
	add	w5, w5, 1
	csel	w6, w6, w3, le
	cmp	w1, w5
	bgt	L4
	mov	w0, w7
	ret
